runtime.rebuildSourceLimit: full rule rebuild clamps source content count by maxRebuildSources
runtime.requestLimit: admin save/delete/rebuild reject request bodies beyond maxRequestBytes before JSON parse
runtime.accessIntegration: related.list filters restricted content when content.access is enabled
runtime.categoryBindIntegration: same-category rule rebuild and public related result rows read content_category_bind when content.category is enabled and keep legacy category_id only as old-data fallback
runtime.rulePreview: admin preview explains same-category candidates, shared tag/topic counts, score formula, reason text and final rule weights without writing content_related
runtime.rebuildResultUi: ability page renders related.rebuild result as a bounded operation table while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.adminStats: related.stats returns relation totals, relationType aggregates and current ruleConfig for admin diagnostics without changing recommendation rules
runtime.adminStatsUi: ability page renders related.stats as relation totals, rule diagnostics and relation type aggregate tables while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.ruleConfigDiagnostics: related.stats exposes ruleLimit, publishRefreshLimit, maxRebuildSources, categoryWeight, tagWeight, topicWeight and ruleFormula as read-only diagnostics
runtime.statusValidation: manual related save normalizes status to enabled/disabled values before writing
